title: Plumbing Repair Checklist
subtitle: Residential Plumbing Repair: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Plumbing Repair Checklist covers fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish. The plumbing service coordinator records Residential Plumbing Repair criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Plumbing Repair Checklist keeps Residential Plumbing Repair exceptions visible until the plumbing service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Plumbing Repair Checklist at residence, room, fixture, shutoff point, and affected downstream area. Document fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish identity before Residential Plumbing Repair begins. Compare fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish findings with stated Residential Plumbing Repair criteria; route unresolved Residential Plumbing Repair issues to qualified plumbing service reviewer. For Plumbing Repair Checklist, confirm requirements for Residential Plumbing Repair. Ask qualified plumbing service reviewer to review Residential Plumbing Repair conditions beyond the plumbing service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Residential Plumbing Repair, identify responsible parties, residence, room, fixture, shutoff point, and affected downstream area, and the linked fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish source.

fields.label: Fixture, line, valve, appliance, or drain identifier
Leak or blockage onset, usage condition, and prior repair

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Plumbing Repair facts for fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Plumbing Repair inspection checks
items: Active leak location, rate, and affected materials
Supply pressure, shutoff, valve, and connection condition
Drain flow, backup, trap, vent, and cleanout observation
Fixture mounting, seal, and functional behavior
Water-heating or appliance connection where in scope
Post-repair leak, flow, and drainage test

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Residential Plumbing Repair finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Plumbing Service Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Uncontrolled water flow or contamination concern
Concealed damage or mold-like condition outside scope
Gas, electrical, structural, or utility conflict
Repair requires unavailable shutdown or authority
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Plumbing Repair when water control, contamination, concealed damage, utility conflict, or safe test remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Plumbing Repair proof and route unresolved fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish scope to plumbing service coordinator.
